verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code review product whose agents generate and push fixes and run codebase scans, so a configurable execution environment is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows a reproducible cloud environment with repository dependencies or setup steps. cubic.yaml configures only review behavior, ignore patterns, PR descriptions and custom agents, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs
